subject: Temporary 'Invoice-first' onboarding request — MarketPulse pilot
messages:
From: Dana Brooks <dana@marketpulse.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement_ops@vendorservices.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: temporary 'invoice-first' onboarding for MarketPulse pilot

Hi Marissa / Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — MarketPulse is excited to get a short pilot live next week. Our procurement team needs vendor setup completed to process the first invoice, but we can’t get a PO in place quickly because our internal Legal review is still in progress.

Would Redwood consider a temporary "invoice-first" onboarding for this 6-week pilot? Proposed constraints:
- Pilot cap: $12,000 total
- Invoices submitted Net-30
- MarketPulse will provide W-9, SOW, and proof of insurance (attached)

We can sign an onboarding acknowledgement and provide a dedicated billing contact to speed approvals. If you need a PO after the pilot, we will commit to generating it.

Attachments: MarketPulse_SOW.pdf (SOW), MarketPulse_W-9.pdf (W-9)

Please let me know required info and if this is something your procurement team can provision as an exception for pilots.

Best,
Dana Brooks
Head of Ops, MarketPulse
Dana.Brooks@marketpulse.ai
(415) 555-0142
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-11T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary 'invoice-first' onboarding for MarketPulse pilot

Dana — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the SOW/W-9. We can move quickly on this. A couple of clarifying items before I loop procurement for a conditional approval:

- Can you confirm MarketPulse insurance carrier and limits?
- Billing email and invoicing cadence (one invoice at kickoff or weekly?)
- Do you require Redwood to enter any vendor-specific payment terms on your side?

Procurement at Redwood typically requires a PO for new vendors, but we do have an "invoice-first" pilot path for trusted partners with a capped spend. I'll initiate the checklist internally (attached) and open a DocuSign for your onboarding acknowledgement. If procurement agrees, we can provision billing as a temporary vendor record so Finance can process Net-30.

Next steps for us: I will share the checklist and a DocuSign link; Priyom will confirm the exception criteria. If it helps speed things, we can accept the first invoice via ACH once vendor banking is supplied (Finance may request a verification call).

Attachment: onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary 'invoice-first' onboarding for MarketPulse pilot

Marissa / Soojin — I'm looping in procurement's standard exception language and recommended guardrails. We can approve a temporary invoice-first onboarding for pilots under the following conditions: 

1) Maximum pilot spend: $15,000 (one-time cap)
2) Onboarding evidence: W-9, SOW, COI (proof of insurance), vendor bank details or verified payment method
3) No active POs required during the pilot; Redwood will require a PO to be created for any ongoing relationship after the pilot or if total spend exceeds the cap
4) Finance pre-approval: first invoice may be held for verification; net-30 terms apply after verification
5) Escalation: any disputes or chargebacks will pause processing until resolved

If MarketPulse needs faster payment for the first invoice and the amount exceeds $5k, procurement requests a refundable security deposit or escrow arrangement to mitigate credit risk. Otherwise, Finance will process Net-30 after standard verification (2–5 business days).

I will prepare an internal approval note and a short exception memo for the compliance folder. Please confirm MarketPulse's COI and billing contact.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Brooks <dana@marketpulse.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary 'invoice-first' onboarding for MarketPulse pilot

Dana — quick update and decision from Redwood procurement: we will grant a temporary invoice-first onboarding for the MarketPulse pilot with the following binding conditions (summary):

- Pilot cap: $15,000 total (hard cap)
- Required evidence: signed SOW, W-9 (received), COI (please attach), and vendor banking (for ACH verification)
- Payment: Finance will process Net-30 after standard verification (2–5 business days). If the first invoice is >$5k and you need faster payment, we require an escrow or refundable deposit as Priyom suggested
- PO transition: A PO must be created for any renewal or ongoing relationship beyond the pilot or if cumulative spend exceeds the cap
- Timeline: please return the COI and vendor banking details by EOD Monday (2026-06-21) to avoid delays; DocuSign onboarding acknowledgement will follow from Marissa

Marissa: please send the DocuSign and HubSpot link to Dana (and mark as "Invoice-first exception: MarketPulse pilot"). Priyom: I'll need the internal exception memo filed and a copy in the compliance folder. Markus: please coordinate with Finance for ACH verification cadence.

Dana — appreciate your flexibility. Once we have COI and bank verification, we will mark MarketPulse as a temporary vendor and Finance can accept the first invoice.
